name: auth
description: Accounts with kit auth: register, log in, log out, and PostgreSQL sessions, with login pages.

name: backups
description: Continuous PostgreSQL backups with pgBackRest: full, differential, and WAL to encrypted S3-compatible storage.

name: ci
description: Build, test, deploy, verify backups, and propose upgrades with GitHub Actions.

name: deploy
description: Production Compose for blue/green deploys, Caddy, a Postgres image with pgBackRest, cloud-init, and environments.

name: jobs
description: Background jobs on River: a worker process and River migrations in the migrate step.

name: mail
description: Typed email templates, SMTP delivery, Mailpit, and optional River retries.

name: monitoring
description: Production monitoring next to the app: Alloy, Prometheus, Loki, and Grafana (lite), plus Tempo and exporters (full).

name: secrets
description: Encrypted secrets for each environment with sops and age.

name: tofu
description: OpenTofu infrastructure for a Hetzner Cloud VM.
